newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Rivet signs acquisition agreement.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Rivet signs acquisition agreement.

text.p: Chicago Rivet & Machine Co said Wednesday it has signed an agreement to acquire nearly all the assets and certain liabilities of H&L Tool Co.
Under the agreement, the price is expected to be about $19.1 million, the company said, though the exact price will be adjusted according to changes in the value of certain assets.
It is expected to be financed by a combination of cash, $4.8 million in credit, the assumption of certain liabilities and outside borrowing between $8 million and $9 million.
Chicago Rivet will purchase all of H&L's production equipment and facilities, it said.
The company said it hopes to close the transaction on October 31.
